title: isomorphic-git checkout can write through directory symlinks outside the working tree
summary: A malicious repository can use successive checkout states to redirect file writes through a directory symlink. Host impact depends on the filesystem provider.

severity.rationale: Checking out untrusted repositories can overwrite files and potentially enable code execution. This common developer workflow warrants a 72-hour response.

exposure: Exposed applications use isomorphic-git checkout on untrusted repositories; host writes depend on filesystem access.

remediation.details: Upgrade isomorphic-git to 1.38.6 or later before further untrusted checkouts.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updating or containment can interrupt dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the installed and running component meets the documented fix or containment condition.
